title: ‘Insidious: Out of the Further’ Director Jacob Chase to Helm Horror Movie ‘Sleepover’ for Blumhouse Atomic Monster and Universal
content:
ByPat Saperstein

Deputy Editor

“Insidious: Out of the Further” directorJacob Chaseis set to direct the horror project “Sleepover” forBlumhouse Atomic Monsterand Universal Pictures. Described as the “quintessential sleepover nightmare,” it’s set for an Oct. 8, 2027 theatrical release.

Chase directs from a screenplay co-written with “Night Swim” screenwriter Bryce McGuire, adapted from McGuire’s original short story.

Blumhouse Atomic Monster also presented Chase’s “Insidious: Out of the Further” along with Sony. The sixth installment in the “Insidious” franchise opened this past weekend to a solid $60 million worldwide. Chase has also directed “Come Play.”

Ahead of the “Insidious: Out of the Further” release, ChasetoldVariety, “Scaring people is kind of like magic — literally magic tricks — which is also something I had a real affinity for growing up,” he says. “It’s all misdirection, right? It’s figuring out how you can constantly surprise an audience in the way that the best magic tricks do.”

Jason Blum will produce, while Chase, McGuire and Bea Sequiera serve as executive producers. Lilly Tyson will oversee the project for Blumhouse Atomic Monster.

“Sleepover” is a Cinescape Entertainment production presented by Universal and Blumhouse Atomic Monster.

Chase is represented by CAA, Gang, Tyre, Ramer, Brown & Passman, and The Initiative Group. McGuire is represented by Gersh and Ziffren Brittenham.
title_zh: 《陰兒房：超越陰界》(Insidious: Out of the Further) 導演雅各·蔡斯(Jacob Chase)將執導驚悚電影《睡衣派對》(Sleepover)，該片由布倫哈姆斯·原子怪物(Blumhouse Atomic Monster)和環球影業(Universal)製作。
content_zh:
作者：帕特·薩佩斯坦(Pat Saperstein)

副編輯

《陰兒房：超越恐懼》(Insidious: Out of the Further) 導演雅各·蔡斯(Jacob Chase) 將為布倫哈姆斯·原子怪物(Blumhouse Atomic Monster) 和環球影業(Universal Pictures) 執導恐怖項目《睡衣派對》(Sleepover)。該片被描述為「典型的睡衣派對噩夢」，預計將於2027年10月8日上映。

蔡斯將根據與《夜泳》(Night Swim) 編劇布萊斯·麥圭爾(Bryce McGuire) 共同撰寫的劇本執導，該劇本改編自麥圭爾的原創短篇故事。

布倫哈姆斯·原子怪物也曾與索尼(Sony) 一起推出蔡斯的《陰兒房：超越恐懼》。該系列的第六部作品在上週末全球票房穩定，達到6000萬美元。蔡斯還執導過《來玩吧》(Come Play)。

在《陰兒房：超越恐懼》上映之前，蔡斯告訴《綜藝》(Variety)：「嚇人就像魔法——字面上的魔術——這也是我從小就非常喜愛的東西。」他表示，「這一切都是誤導，對吧？這就是要找出如何不斷地以最佳魔術的方式驚喜觀眾。」

傑森·布倫(Jason Blum) 將擔任製片人，而蔡斯、麥圭爾和比亞·塞基拉(Bea Sequiera) 將擔任執行製片人。莉莉·泰森(Lilly Tyson) 將為布倫哈姆斯·原子怪物監督該項目。

《睡衣派對》是由環球影業和布倫哈姆斯·原子怪物共同呈現的Cinescape Entertainment製作。

蔡斯由CAA、Gang, Tyre, Ramer, Brown & Passman以及The Initiative Group 代表。麥圭爾則由Gersh和Ziffren Brittenham 代表。
